Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow reduces armor and slows, so move opposite the direction where the axe lands to prevent him from picking it up. When Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t try to catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp; create distance and use it after the effect ends. Even at low health, Olaf gains attack speed and life steal, so don’t rush to finish him.
Olaf.fight: While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don’t stay close and fight him. Create distance, then engage with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp after it ends. After trading damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible to use its shield against the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing as well.
Olaf.combo: After Olaf R Ragnarok ends, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit only Olaf with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Land three hits with abilities and basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then use the movement speed boost to stay on him. Once exchanging damage has built up your stored resource, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible to gain a shield.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance on his own, so prevent him from picking up Olaf Q Undertow’s axe and engage after Olaf R Ragnarok ends. If you pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp then, he can’t escape with an ability before using Flash.
Olaf.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Olaf Q Undertow. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage that can’t be reduced by resistances, so get health as well.
Olaf.laning: Avoid extended fights in the early game so Olaf doesn’t get a kill. Move opposite the direction where Olaf Q Undertow’s axe lands to prevent him from picking it up, and look for a trade when Olaf steps forward to last-hit. Hit only Olaf with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, without overlapping a minion.
Olaf.phase: Olaf is strong in the early game, so avoid giving him a kill and stall for time. In the mid game, use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death when you have a clear chance to win. In the late game, take advantage of Olaf being relatively weaker. In late-game teamfights, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can isolate only one enemy, so choose your target carefully.
Olaf.teamfight: If Olaf reaches an allied damage dealer, you can take him away with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop his engage. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and wait it out, then pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Endure the fight with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active, but use R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill within its duration.

KSante.build: Since K'Sante can lock you down with chained crowd control, you can prioritize tenacity. Build armor against the physical damage from K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct, K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, and K'Sante W Path Maker, and get health to withstand the true damage from K'Sante W Path Maker. Magic resistance won’t help against this opponent’s main damage.
KSante.combo: Pull K'Sante in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp from an angle that doesn’t overlap a minion, then hit him in this order: attack, Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, attack. These three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise; use the movement speed boost to stick close and fight. Use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield after trading damage, and convert it to healing when the shield is thick if you won’t take more damage.
KSante.escape: After K'Sante has used both K'Sante W Path Maker and K'Sante E Footwork, look for a chance to catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. If K'Sante R All Out is also down, he has fewer ways to escape by chaining other mobility tools. Engage only after dodging the pull and stun from empowered K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes.
KSante.fight: Start trading when K'Sante steps forward to last-hit and you can dodge his charging K'Sante W Path Maker or empowered K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes. Close the gap with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then use Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield after trading damage once. When K'Sante R All Out is active, focus your damage on the more vulnerable K'Sante, but don’t endure his increased damage and lifesteal alone for too long.
KSante.phase: In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take only one enemy, so its impact depends on the enemy team composition and your target choice.
KSante.teamfight: Group several enemies with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, then endure the fight with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s aura active. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill within its duration, after the enemy’s key champion has used their major abilities. If K'Sante engages on an allied damage dealer, you can take K'Sante away to stop the engage. If you have to fight K'Sante for a long time while K'Sante R All Out is active, make sure your team has a way to apply healing reduction.
KSante.watch: If you’ve been hit by K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes repeatedly or K'Sante has built stacks by hitting minions, move out of range to avoid the pull and stun from his next shockwave. When you see K'Sante W Path Maker charging, save Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and your damage until its unstoppable effect and damage reduction end, and sidestep the charge. Don’t stand with a wall behind you when facing K'Sante, so K'Sante R All Out can’t knock you over a wall.

Aatrox.phase: Early on, Aatrox can grow strong quickly if he gets an advantage, so farm without giving him a kill. The matchup improves over time, but late game your impact depends on the enemy composition, since Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can isolate only one champion.
Aatrox.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If long trades make the healing from Aatrox P Deathbringer Stance, Aatrox E Umbral Dash, and Aatrox R World Ender a problem, buy Morellonomicon.
Aatrox.combo: When Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in one basic attack, then hit him with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that hits only Aatrox, not the minions. After three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then chase with the increased movement speed.
Aatrox.escape: Right after you make Aatrox use Aatrox E Umbral Dash is your chance to catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains catches you, first walk out of its area to avoid being pulled back. Avoid dueling while Aatrox R World Ender is active, then engage again after it expires.
Aatrox.fight: Trade right after Aatrox uses an empowered attack on a minion or casts Aatrox E Umbral Dash. Avoid the tip of Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, and stay close while weaving in basic attacks until your passive aura activates. Activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible after you have dealt and taken damage and built up a shield.
Aatrox.laning: Early on, manage your distance and farm without giving Aatrox a kill.
Aatrox.teamfight: Pull multiple enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hold your ground within range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and your passive aura. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill within its duration, after they have used their key abilities. If Aatrox dives your carries, you can isolate him with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death, but avoid dueling him while Aatrox R World Ender is active.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade deals threatening damage and can knock you up, so watch its cast animation and dodge outside the blade’s tip range or move in close. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, immediately walk out of its area to avoid being pulled back. Aatrox R World Ender increases his healing, so create distance and fight after it expires.

DrMundo.teamfight: Pull multiple enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and fight within range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important enemy you can kill within its duration, and do not target a hard-to-kill frontline champion such as a healing Dr. Mundo. It is safer to use your ultimate after an enemy key champion has used their major abilities.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw slows the first target it hits and deals more damage the higher their current health is. Stand behind minions to dodge it, and watch for the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma and the healing and movement speed increase from Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first against Dr. Mundo's main damage, Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If duels drag on because of the healing from Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases, Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw, and Dr. Mundo W Heart Zapper, buy Morellonomicon.
DrMundo.combo: If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then use Mordekaiser Q Obliterate to hit Dr. Mundo alone. Land three ability and basic attack hits to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then stay close and fight. Use Mordekaiser W Indestructible as a shield after you have dealt and taken damage, and convert the remaining shield into healing if you will not take more damage.
DrMundo.escape: Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, so catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp when Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down. Block Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw with minions or dodge it before engaging to avoid the slow.
DrMundo.fight: When Dr. Mundo steps forward to last-hit, you have a chance to trade. However, Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases ignores the first immobilizing effect, so you cannot pull him in right away with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp while his passive is available. After his passive is down, close in with E and weave in basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
DrMundo.laning: Look for an advantage with Mordekaiser's magic damage while Dr. Mundo has low magic resistance early. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that hits only Dr. Mundo, not the minions. After trading, stomp on the canister Mundo drops while retreating to deny its healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: Early on, use Dr. Mundo's low magic resistance to secure an advantage in lane. That advantage fades as he levels up, and while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, shift your efforts to another lane or an objective instead of spending time trying to kill him. Late game, choose a target based on the enemy composition, since Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can isolate only one champion.

Kennen.laning: Don’t push the wave against ranged Kennen. Farm safely with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Stand behind minions to block Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken, and only step forward briefly to last-hit.
Kennen.build: Next, build magic resistance to withstand Kennen’s magic damage.
Kennen.combo: After Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Weave in an attack, then angle Mordekaiser Q Obliterate to hit Kennen alone and activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After trading damage once, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield.
Kennen.escape: The window to engage is when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down. If Kennen P Mark of the Storm has two stacks, back off first and engage after the stacks expire.
Kennen.fight: When Kennen E Lightning Rush is down, close the gap with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hit Mordekaiser Q Obliterate without overlapping a minion.
Kennen.phase: In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can isolate only one enemy, so its impact depends on the enemy team composition and your target choice.
Kennen.teamfight: Anticipate Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom’s engage angle and spread out from your allies. After Kennen uses his key abilities, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s aura, and endure the fight. If Kennen engages on an allied damage dealer, look for a chance to isolate him with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Kennen.watch: Dodge Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken by keeping minions between you and him. When Kennen P Mark of the Storm reaches two stacks, briefly back off to avoid the third hit and stun. In teamfights, stay apart from your allies to avoid the AoE stun from Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom.

Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast lowers your resistances and slows you, so avoid taking a direct hit. Kayle E Starfire Spellblade deals damage based on your missing health, so be especially careful when your health is low. While Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, don’t unload damage; attack again once the invulnerability ends.
Kayle.build: Prioritize magic resistance on your defensive items against Kayle’s main damage. Still, avoid a direct hit from Kayle Q Radiant Blast, since it reduces your resistances. If healing from Kayle W Celestial Blessing becomes a problem, build Morellonomicon and keep the healing reduction up with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
Kayle.combo: Pull Kayle in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in one attack, then hit Kayle with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that doesn’t overlap a minion. These three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise; use the movement speed boost to chase. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, disrupt her movement with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp instead of unloading your damage, then attack once her invulnerability ends.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no mobility ability, so it’s a good time to engage when you dodge the slow from Kayle Q Radiant Blast. Kayle can use Kayle W Celestial Blessing’s movement speed to escape, so catch her first with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp when she steps forward. If Kayle R Divine Judgment has already been used, you can start a fight without waiting out her invulnerability.
Kayle.fight: Hit her with attacks and Mordekaiser Q Obliterate to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then stick close and fight. After trading damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible.
Kayle.teamfight: Take a path to reach Kayle from the flank or outside vision so she can’t keep attacking from the backline. Engage when Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp lands together with your allies’ crowd control, and focus your damage after the invulnerability from Kayle R Divine Judgment ends. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on a target you can kill within its duration; don’t cast it carelessly on Kayle, who can use her invulnerability immediately.

Quinn.phase: Quinn outranges you in the early laning phase, so Mordekaiser should preserve his health and farm.
Quinn.build: Build armor first. Quinn P Harrier, Quinn Q Blinding Assault, and Quinn E Vault all deal physical damage, so you don’t need magic resistance for this matchup.
Quinn.combo: Right after Quinn E Vault is down, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Avoid the minions and hit Quinn alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, then follow with a basic attack. After three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise and chase with the increased movement speed.
Quinn.escape: The moment Quinn E Vault is down is your window to engage. Until then, don’t force the gap closed because Quinn can retreat. Once you confirm it’s down, catch her with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp.
Quinn.fight: Look for a fight when Quinn E Vault is down or your jungler arrives. Close the gap with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, then hit Quinn with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate without hitting minions and weave in basic attacks. After trading damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield.
Quinn.laning: Early on, don’t push the wave. Farm safely with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and preserve your health. When Quinn P Harrier marks you, back off and let the mark expire; farm while you’re unmarked.
Quinn.teamfight: If Quinn approaches from the side, catch her with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and fight within range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After the enemy’s key champion uses their major abilities, use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on a target you can kill within its duration. Choose your engage position carefully, since it’s hard to catch up again once you back off.
Quinn.watch: When Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of Quinn’s range to avoid her empowered basic attack. Block Quinn Q Blinding Assault by standing behind minions, and if your vision is reduced, don’t cast Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp during that time. Quinn E Vault interrupts your approach and sends her backward, so don’t force an engage before it is down.

Yasuo.laning: Reduce the number of minions Yasuo can use as stepping stones for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, and keep the wave thin on your side of the lane to make it harder for him to approach. Use Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that hits only Yasuo, without overlapping with minions.
Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Armor doesn’t apply to the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, and attack speed reduction also lengthens the interval before Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado becomes available again.
Yasuo.combo: Hitting E, a basic attack, and Q activates the Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise aura, so use the movement speed bonus to stay on him. If you have a clear opening for a duel, cast Mordekaiser R Realm of Death right after using E to close the gap.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo fires the Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado, his knock-up stacks reset, giving you a chance to engage. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade has a short cooldown, so don’t engage just because he used it once. Land Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp with crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back.
Yasuo.fight: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then start a full trade. Right after he fires the Yasuo Q Steel Tempest tornado, when he steps up to last-hit, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp to start the fight. After trading damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield.
Yasuo.phase: The available information isn’t enough to judge who has the advantage in the mid game. In the late game, R can take only one enemy, so its impact depends on the enemy composition.
Yasuo.teamfight: Pull in multiple enemies with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and hold your ground within range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. If Yasuo dives onto an allied damage dealer, look for a chance to take him with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death. Use R on an enemy you can kill within its duration, after a key enemy champion has used their key abilities.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you up with a tornado after successive hits, so if its stacks are full, move off its line and sidestep. If he knocks you up after closing in with Yasuo E Sweeping Blade, he can follow with Yasuo R Last Breath. Mordekaiser has no ability to escape on his own, so manage your distance first.

Akali.build: Build magic resistance first and add health to withstand Akali's magic damage and the execute range of Akali R Perfect Execution. Akali's high magic resistance blocks much of Mordekaiser's main magic damage, so do not delay leveling up Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp for the magic penetration on its passive.
Akali.combo: Pull Akali in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and weave in basic attacks, then hit her with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate when she is away from the minions. Follow with a basic attack to land the third hit and activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then use Mordekaiser W Indestructible's shield after you have dealt and taken damage. When Akali's mobility tools are down and you can fight her, close the gap with E and immediately cast Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Akali.escape: Do not engage just because Akali W Twilight Shroud is down. Dodge Akali E Shuriken Flip, wait for her other mobility tools to be down, and engage with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, especially before Akali R Perfect Execution comes back up. While she is in the shroud, aim E or Mordekaiser Q Obliterate for the moment she briefly becomes visible.
Akali.fight: Pull Akali in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to start a trade when she steps up to last-hit or comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to engage. Dodge the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip, then make sure her other mobility tools are down before closing in and activating Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Use Mordekaiser W Indestructible as a shield after you have dealt and taken damage.
Akali.phase: Late game, your impact depends on the enemy composition and target selection, since R can isolate only one champion.
Akali.teamfight: If Akali dives your carries, take her into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop her engage. Check whether you can kill her, and if possible, cast R after she has used her key abilities. Pull multiple enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hold your ground within range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
Akali.watch: The most important thing is to dodge the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, her second dash will follow. You cannot dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, so be ready to push her away with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp as she engages. The second hit of Akali R Perfect Execution grows stronger in proportion to missing health.

Aurora.build: Aurora's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first and also get movement speed to leave telegraphed areas. If healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration becomes a problem, buy Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds with the damage over time from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
Aurora.combo: When Aurora's mobility abilities are down, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and land basic attacks and Mordekaiser Q Obliterate to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that hits only Aurora, not the minions. After damage has accumulated in the ensuing fight, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible. If Aurora's escape tools are down and she is in range, force a duel with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Aurora.escape: Do not engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil is down; check Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora R Between Worlds as well. Engage with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp when Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora W Across the Veil are both down, especially before Aurora R Between Worlds comes back up.
Aurora.fight: Fight after Aurora W Across the Veil and Aurora E The Weirding are down, closing the gap with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. While Aurora is stealthed with Aurora W Across the Veil, do not rush Mordekaiser R Realm of Death; wait until she is visible again and within reliable range. After you have dealt and taken damage, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield, and convert the remaining shield into healing if you will not take more damage.
Aurora.laning: Early on, do not push the wave and lose health chasing ranged Aurora; farm safely with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate.
Aurora.phase: Early on, protect your health and farm instead of chasing ranged Aurora recklessly. Late game, choose an important target you can kill carefully, since Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take only one champion.
Aurora.teamfight: If Aurora jumps in and has not participated in a takedown, catch her with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp while her mobility tool is down. If you can pull in multiple enemies, gather them within range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise and hold your ground. If you can kill Aurora within the duration after she uses her key abilities, make her the target of Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, move off the line between Aurora and yourself to reduce the return damage. The lower your health, the higher the return damage, so do not stay under the curse. Leaving the area after Aurora R Between Worlds is cast slows you, so decide whether to retreat before the zone appears or fight inside it.

Camille.build: Build armor first against Camille's main damage. Resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and Camille W Tactical Sweep deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone. If healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep becomes a problem, buy Morellonomicon.
Camille.combo: When Camille E Hookshot's hook catches a wall, interrupt her dash and close the gap with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Follow with a basic attack, then Mordekaiser Q Obliterate aimed to avoid the minions, to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After you have dealt and taken damage once, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield, and convert the remaining shield into healing if you will not take more damage.
Camille.escape: Even if Camille E Hookshot is down, Camille can escape with another mobility tool if Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is still available, so do not rush your engage. Close in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp when Camille E Hookshot is down and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is not back up yet.
Camille.fight: Avoid trading just after Camille P Adaptive Defenses activates its shield; engage after the shield is removed, when Camille steps forward to last-hit. It is a good window to engage if Camille E Hookshot is down and Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is not back up yet.
Camille.laning: Stand between minions and away from walls so you are not pushed toward a wall. Camille is weak before her first core item, so take control of the lane and deny her farm before then. When trading with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, aim from an angle that hits only Camille, not the minions.
Camille.phase: From midgame onward, respond to Camille's side lane pressure, since leaving her alone can quickly cost you a turret. Late game, Mordekaiser's impact depends on whom you take into R Realm of Death.
Camille.teamfight: Pull multiple enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hold your ground with P Darkness Rise active. If Camille dives your carries, you can take her into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop her engage. After the opponents' key abilities have been spent, use R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill within its duration.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot is a wall-assisted dash that stuns you on hit and increases her attack speed. Stand away from walls, and interrupt her dash with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp as her hook catches the wall.

Chogath.build: Prioritize magic resistance against the damage from Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes. Resistance cannot block the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast, and E Vorpal Spikes scales with maximum health, so be cautious about stacking health alone. If healing from Cho'Gath P Carnivore becomes a problem, buy Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds with the damage over time from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
Chogath.combo: When Cho'Gath steps up to last-hit, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then cast Q Obliterate so it hits Cho'Gath alone. Follow with a basic attack for the third hit to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then stay close with the increased movement speed. After you have dealt and taken damage, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible's shield, and if you will not take more damage, convert it to healing while the shield is still large.
Chogath.escape: Cho'Gath has no mobility ability, so after he uses Q Rupture or W Feral Scream is your chance to catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Conversely, when you see the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture, walk sideways first; if W Feral Scream silences you, create distance with movement instead of abilities.
Chogath.fight: Stay out of the path of Cho'Gath W Feral Scream, and once you are close, weave in basic attacks until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. After you have dealt and taken damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible to get a shield.
Chogath.laning: Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pass through minions, so move off the line where his basic attack direction and the minions overlap. Early on, push the lane or pressure his last-hit position to give Cho'Gath fewer chances to stack. If your health is in a precarious range, create distance to avoid being killed by Cho'Gath R Feast.
Chogath.phase: Cho'Gath's stacks make the matchup harder over time, so late game, focus on avoiding a kill from Cho'Gath R Feast when your health is in a precarious range.
Chogath.teamfight: Pull multiple enemies into range of Q Obliterate and P Darkness Rise with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, and choose your engage position carefully. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill within its duration, after an enemy key champion has used their major abilities. If Cho'Gath has too much health to kill in time, choose another target, but you can take Cho'Gath into R Realm of Death to stop his engage if he gets onto your carries.
Chogath.watch: Cho'Gath Q Rupture knocks you up and slows you after a warning appears beneath you, so immediately walk sideways when you see the mark. If Cho'Gath W Feral Scream hits you with its frontal silence, it is hard to dodge the follow-up Q Rupture, so stay out of its path. If your health is at or below half, move out of range of Cho'Gath R Feast, which deals true damage.

Darius.build: Build armor first against Darius's main damage. Darius E Apprehend's armor penetration bypasses some armor, and Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage, so build health too. If healing from Darius Q Decimate becomes a problem, buy Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds with the damage over time from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
Darius.combo: During the window when Darius E Apprehend is down, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, hit Darius alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, then follow with another basic attack. After three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise and stay close using the movement speed increase. After you have dealt and taken damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible, and if you will not take more damage, convert the shield into healing while it is still large.
Darius.escape: The window when Darius E Apprehend has missed or cannot be recast is your chance to engage with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Look for an opening while Darius R Noxian Guillotine is down too, but retreat to break the stacks if Darius P Hemorrhage builds up.
Darius.fight: After Darius E Apprehend misses or is down, start a trade with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp when Darius steps forward to last-hit. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate to hit only Darius, not the minions, and weave in basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Do not prolong the fight while Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build; retreat to break them.
Darius.laning: Trade briefly and disengage just after Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions or casts E Apprehend into empty space.
Darius.phase: Late game, Mordekaiser's impact depends on the enemy composition and target selection, since R can take only one champion.
Darius.teamfight: Pull multiple enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hold your ground with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill within its duration, after an enemy key champion has used their major abilities. If you remain in the fight with several stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage on you, Darius R Noxian Guillotine can put your allies at risk through its recast after a kill, so get out of range.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, you are likely to get hit by follow-up attacks, so wait outside its range and approach after it misses. When you see Darius Q Decimate, move outside the blade or hug him to reduce his healing. If stacks of Darius P Hemorrhage build up, create distance to break them; with several stacks, get completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

Fiora.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. Resistance cannot block the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge, and stacking health alone also increases R's damage based on your maximum health. If healing becomes a problem, buy Morellonomicon.
Fiora.combo: After confirming Fiora W Riposte is down, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in one basic attack, then hit her alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Land a third hit with another basic attack to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After you have dealt and taken damage, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible, and if you will not take more damage, convert the shield into healing while it is still large.
Fiora.escape: Right after making Fiora use Q Lunge is your chance to engage. If Fiora W Riposte is down too, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to make it difficult for her to escape.
Fiora.fight: Close the gap with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp after Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora W Riposte are down. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that hits only Fiora, not the minions, and weave in basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After you have dealt and taken damage once, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible's shield.
Fiora.laning: Stand opposite the direction of the exposed vital and use the moment Fiora dives in with Fiora Q Lunge as a chance to counterattack. After a short trade, do not chase recklessly.
Fiora.teamfight: If Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, hug a wall so you do not expose all four vitals. Pull multiple enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hold your ground with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill within its duration, after an enemy key champion has used their major abilities.
Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte can block Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and parry back, so do not use E carelessly while her Riposte is available. Watch for Fiora Q Lunge as she dives toward a vital, and if Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, hug a wall to block a vital on one side.

Gangplank.build: Build armor early in lane to withstand Gangplank Q Parrrley poke and the physical damage from Gangplank E Powder Keg. You also need health to withstand true damage. If the healing from Gangplank W Remove Scurvy becomes a problem, buy Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds with the damage over time from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
Gangplank.combo: Pull Gangplank in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to close the gap, then weave in a basic attack and hit Gangplank alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that doesn’t overlap with minions. Land three hits in total with abilities and basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then chase with the movement speed increase. After trading damage, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield. Cast Mordekaiser R Realm of Death immediately after the pull if Gangplank is within range.
Gangplank.escape: Engage just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed or after Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is used. Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so when you have an opening, catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and keep fighting.
Gangplank.fight: A trade window opens just after Gangplank E Powder Keg is placed, while it is still unprimed. When Gangplank steps forward to last-hit, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and stay on him, weaving in basic attacks until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. Keep in mind that Gangplank W Remove Scurvy can cleanse crowd control if it is available.
Gangplank.laning: Gangplank Q Parrrley poke can chip away at your health, so build armor early and avoid trading near a primed Gangplank E Powder Keg.
Gangplank.phase: From mid game onward, track whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used to time objective fights. In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take only one enemy, so its impact depends on the enemy team composition.
Gangplank.teamfight: Pull multiple enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and stay alive with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill within its duration, after the enemy’s key champion has used their major abilities. Check whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage is available, since it can affect objective fights.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank E Powder Keg slows when it explodes, so back away if a primed keg is nearby and destroy it from outside the blast radius. Don’t step where two kegs overlap.

Garen.build: Build armor first since Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment deal most of their damage as physical damage. Health also matters against the true damage from Garen R Demacian Justice, which armor and magic resistance cannot mitigate. Buy Morellonomicon if the healing from Garen P Perseverance becomes a problem.
Garen.combo: Start after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s silence is down and the shield and tenacity from Garen W Courage have worn off. Pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit Garen alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that doesn’t overlap with minions. Add more basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then use Mordekaiser W Indestructible after trading damage.
Garen.escape: Garen has no ability to create distance on his own, so catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp when Garen Q Decisive Strike’s silence is down. If he has just activated Garen W Courage, wait out the brief shield and tenacity before using E. If Garen E Judgment is spinning, move out of its area first.
Garen.fight: Right after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered basic attack is used, pull in Garen as he steps up to last-hit with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to start a trade. Activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise with basic attacks and Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, but don’t fight for long inside Garen E Judgment’s spin. After trading damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield.
Garen.laning: Push and pressure from the early game to leave Garen little time to build stacks on Garen W Courage. After pushing the wave past him, create a numbers advantage elsewhere.
Garen.phase: In the early game, push and pressure to slow Garen’s growth. Garen grows stronger over time because stacks from Garen W Courage are permanent. In the late game, Mordekaiser R can take only one enemy, so its impact depends on the enemy team composition.
Garen.teamfight: Pull multiple enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and stay alive with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on a target you can kill within its duration, after the enemy’s key champion has used their major abilities. If Garen dives onto an allied damage dealer, you can take Garen into R to stop his engage.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike empowers his basic attack and silences, so don’t engage while it is active. Garen W Courage grants a shield and tenacity right after it is activated, so delay Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp by half a beat. Move out of Garen E Judgment’s spin, and if your health is below half, stay out of range of Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health.

Gnar.build: Build armor first to withstand Gnar’s primary damage. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your max health, so armor alone won’t stop it, and be cautious about stacking health alone. Since Mordekaiser has no mobility, you can prioritize tenacity against Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR!.
Gnar.combo: When Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit him with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Mordekaiser Q Obliterate deals more damage when it hits only Gnar, without overlapping with minions. After three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, chase with the movement speed, and gain a shield with Mordekaiser W Indestructible after trading damage once.
Gnar.escape: Right after making Gnar use Gnar E Hop / Crunch is an opportunity to close the gap with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Watch out for Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! and don’t engage with your back to a wall. Also look for an opening just after he reverts from Mega to Mini, while he can’t transform again.
Gnar.fight: Don’t chase Mini Gnar while taking excessive poke. Close the gap with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp just after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is used. When Gnar has just transformed into Mega Gnar, don’t face him head-on; create distance. Just after he reverts from Mega to Mini, engage and fight during the window when he can’t transform again.
Gnar.laning: In the early game, don’t push the wave. Farm safely with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and collect CS near your turret.
Gnar.phase: In the late game, target selection matters because Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take only one enemy.
Gnar.teamfight: Position yourself so you aren’t between Gnar and a wall, and avoid a head-on fight just after Mega Gnar transforms. Pull multiple enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and fight within range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After Gnar uses his major abilities, take an important target you can kill within its duration into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Gnar.watch: Watch for the slows from Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss, and sidestep the path of Mini Gnar’s boomerang as it returns. If Gnar can’t catch his boomerang, there will be a longer gap before his next poke. Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! stuns you if you hit a wall, so don’t fight with your back to one.

Gwen.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Gwen’s primary damage, and also get armor to account for her basic attack damage. You can’t mitigate the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s true damage with resistances, so dodge it by repositioning. If healing from Gwen P A Thousand Cuts becomes a problem, buy Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds with the damage over time from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
Gwen.combo: When Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then use Mordekaiser Q Obliterate so it hits Gwen alone. Follow up with basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise and stay on her with the movement speed. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, enter it or wait for it to end before using Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Gwen.escape: Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is her mobility, so the moment after she uses it is an opportunity to catch her with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Pull her away from minions and fight where she can’t hit one to get a cooldown refund.
Gwen.fight: Trade before Gwen Q Snip Snip! stacks build up or just after Gwen E Skip 'n Slash is down. When Gwen steps forward to last-hit, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and land abilities and basic attacks until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. When she casts Gwen Q Snip Snip!, move to the side of its center, and activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield after trading damage.
Gwen.laning: In the early game, stay outside Gwen’s basic attack range to reduce her chances to heal with Gwen P A Thousand Cuts. Hit only Gwen with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, without overlapping with minions, and avoid forcing an early dive.
Gwen.phase: In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take only one enemy, so its impact depends on the enemy team composition.
Gwen.teamfight: Pull multiple enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and stay alive within range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. If Gwen dives onto an allied damage dealer, you can take her into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop her engage. If Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, don’t cast Mordekaiser R Realm of Death from outside it, and dodge the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!.
Gwen.watch: The center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! deals true damage, so walk to the side when she casts it. When Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, she can’t be targeted from outside the mist, so use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death after entering it or after it ends. Gwen E Skip 'n Slash gets a large cooldown refund when it hits something, so don’t chase her where there are many minions.

Illaoi.build: Build armor first to withstand the main damage from Illaoi P Prophet of an Elder God, Q Tentacle Smash, and W Harsh Lesson. Illaoi W Harsh Lesson deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. If her healing becomes a problem, buy Morellonomicon to apply Grievous Wounds.
Illaoi.combo: After Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Weave in basic attacks and hit Illaoi alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, without overlapping with minions. Land a total of three hits with abilities and basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then stay on her and fight. Use Mordekaiser W Indestructible once damage has built up.
Illaoi.escape: Engage with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp immediately after making Illaoi use W Harsh Lesson. If you dodged Illaoi E Test of Spirit, this is a window when the risk of being caught is lower.
Illaoi.fight: The moment after Illaoi uses W Harsh Lesson is an opportunity to close the gap. Pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp away from walls and tentacles, then stay on her, weaving in basic attacks until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. After trading damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible.
Illaoi.laning: Keep to a lane position away from walls and last-hit outside the range of Illaoi E Test of Spirit. When Illaoi steps forward to last-hit, start a trade with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Don’t take a fight where tentacles are set up, and don’t force a dive just because Illaoi is at half health.
Illaoi.phase: In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take only one enemy, so its impact depends on the enemy team composition.
Illaoi.teamfight: Don’t fight near Illaoi’s tentacles. If you can’t afford to destroy them, draw her into open ground away from walls. Don’t group up against Illaoi R Leap of Faith, and give her no target to hit for its duration. Pull enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and stay alive with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active, but use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill.
Illaoi.watch: Dodge Illaoi E Test of Spirit. If you can’t fight after your soul is pulled, break the tether and dodge the first tentacle, then wait beside it until the mark expires. When Illaoi uses R Leap of Faith, don’t group up; keep your distance until its short duration ends.

Irelia.build: The data isn’t enough to determine your first purchase or which resistance to build first. If healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge becomes a problem, buy Morellonomicon. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s damage over time makes it easy to maintain Grievous Wounds.
Irelia.combo: When Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and basic attack her, then hit Irelia alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that doesn’t overlap with minions. These three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise; follow up with basic attacks. If you’ve traded damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible. When you have a sure duel, cast Mordekaiser R Realm of Death immediately after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp.
Irelia.escape: The moment after you make Irelia use Irelia Q Bladesurge is an opportunity to close the gap with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also down, engage during a window when the risk of being crowd controlled is lower.
Irelia.fight: When Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and stay on her, weaving in basic attacks until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. After trading damage, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield.
Irelia.laning: However, don’t leave low-health minions between you and Irelia, and back away when a minion is about to die. Look for an opportunity to pull Irelia in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp when she steps forward to last-hit.
Irelia.phase: Your late game impact depends on whether you can take a particular enemy into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia because she can split the fight with Irelia R Vanguard's Edge and stun multiple enemies with Irelia E Flawless Duet. If she dives onto an allied damage dealer, take her into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop her engage. Pull enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and stay alive with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active, but use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on a sure target after Irelia’s major abilities are down.
Irelia.watch: Irelia uses Irelia Q Bladesurge to close in via low-health minions, so create distance when a minion is about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet and the area slow from Irelia R Vanguard's Edge. If you’re trapped in Irelia R Vanguard's Edge’s perimeter, wait until the blades disappear.

Jax.build: The data doesn’t specify a concrete first purchase. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone. Since basic attacks and attack speed are central to his damage, consider ways to reduce his attack speed.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then use Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that hits only Jax. Land a total of three hits with abilities and basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, and gain a shield with Mordekaiser W Indestructible after trading damage once. If you have a sure duel, cast Mordekaiser R Realm of Death right after pulling him in.
Jax.escape: The moment after you make Jax use Jax Q Leap Strike is a window when his mobility is down, so engage by pulling him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. If Jax E Counter Strike is active, wait outside the stun area until it ends, then go in.
Jax.fight: Look for a trade after Jax E Counter Strike is down. If Jax has also used Jax Q Leap Strike, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to maintain your distance, then land abilities and basic attacks until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates.
Jax.laning: Jax has the advantage in a level 1 melee fight, so don’t force an engage.
Jax.phase: Jax gets stronger after completing his first core item. In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take one enemy, so its impact depends on the enemy team composition.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, don’t group with your allies; wait for the area stun to end. You can take Jax into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop his engage if he dives onto an allied damage dealer. After Jax E Counter Strike ends, catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and fight with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active.
Jax.watch: Jax E Counter Strike negates basic attacks and stuns in an area when reactivated. Stop basic attacking while it is active and move outside the stun area; once it ends, close the gap again with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp.

Jayce.build: Build magic resistance first to withstand Jayce W Lightning Field / Hyper Charge and Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate. Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast deals physical damage, which magic resistance won’t mitigate. Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate deals damage based on your max health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Jayce.combo: When Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in one basic attack, then hit him with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Mordekaiser Q Obliterate deals more damage when it hits only Jayce, without overlapping with minions. After three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, gain movement speed, and keep chasing.
Jayce.escape: The moment after you make Jayce use his mobility ability, Jayce Q To the Skies!, is an opportunity to engage. If the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow is also down, close the gap with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and get on him.
Jayce.fight: After the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to start a fight. After trading damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible. If you have a sure opening to stick to him, force a duel with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Jayce.laning: In the early game, don’t push the wave; farm safely with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. When Jayce is holding his cannon, move side to side to dodge Jayce Q Shock Blast, and don’t force yourself to stay in lane after health has been chipped away.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strongest early, so farm defensively. Your late game impact depends on who you can take into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Jayce.teamfight: After the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is down, close the gap, pull enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, and stay alive with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill within its duration, after the enemy’s key champion has used their major abilities.
Jayce.watch: When Jayce E Acceleration Gate is placed, Jayce Q Shock Blast may follow, so sidestep out of its line. When he switches to hammer, watch out for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow.

Kled.build: Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, Kled W Violent Tendencies, and Kled E Jousting deal mainly physical damage, so build armor first. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!. If crowd control locks you down and gets you killed, consider tenacity first; consider a way to reduce attack speed to buy time to dodge Kled W Violent Tendencies’ four attacks.
Kled.combo: Pull Kled in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in an attack, then hit him with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate alone from an angle that doesn’t overlap a minion. Hit three times with abilities and attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then use the movement speed boost to keep fighting. After trading damage once, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield, and convert it to healing when the shield is thick if you won’t take more damage.
Kled.escape: Don’t engage just because Kled E Jousting is down; check whether Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is also available. Kled will have a hard time escaping if Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp hits before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back up. Look for a chance to close the gap even after Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope misses.
Kled.fight: If Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, don’t stay and take all four attacks; disengage, then close in again. Look for a chance to catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back up.
Kled.laning: In the early game, manage your distance so Kled can’t chain Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and Kled E Jousting on you. If you’ve dismounted Kled, check his courage meter and finish him only when you can secure the kill. If killing him looks difficult, create distance and push him out of lane so he can’t kill minions and remount.
Kled.phase: Kled weakens sharply after the laning phase and mid game, so it’s in your favor to get through the early game without trouble and prolong the game.
Kled.teamfight: Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can start from far away outside vision, so maintain vision on the flanks. If you can’t stop his engage in advance, keep your frontliner positioned to take the first charge, and choose to take Kled away with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death as soon as he reaches an allied damage dealer. Pull enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and endure the fight after activating Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, but choose your ultimate target based on whether you can kill them within its duration.
Kled.watch: When Kled W Violent Tendencies is ready, watch out for the max-health damage from his fourth attack and create distance before all four attacks hit. If Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope catches you, move away immediately before it pulls you in. Mordekaiser has no ability to escape on his own, so keep your distance especially while Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! are available.

Malphite.build: Malphite’s main damage from Malphite Q Seismic Shard, E Ground Slam, and R Unstoppable Force is magic, so buy magic resistance items first. Remember that magic resistance can’t block the physical damage from Malphite W Thunderclap. Against Malphite’s armor, rely on the max-health damage from Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise and your main magic damage instead of armor penetration.
Malphite.combo: After breaking Malphite P Granite Shield, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Weave in an attack, hit only Malphite with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, then continue basic attacking to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After trading enough damage, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield, and convert the remaining shield to healing if you won’t take more damage.
Malphite.escape: The moment after Malphite R Unstoppable Force is down is your chance to engage. If you pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp then, he has no mobility besides his ultimate and will struggle to escape. Delay your engage right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits and slows you.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first. When Malphite steps forward to last-hit, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to start a trade. Hit only Malphite with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, without overlapping a minion, and weave in attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After trading damage, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield.
Malphite.laning: Poke at short intervals so Malphite P Granite Shield doesn’t regenerate. Malphite Q Seismic Shard can’t be dodged by standing behind minions, so don’t stay in its range for long.
Malphite.phase: In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can separate only one enemy from the fight, so target selection matters.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Malphite R Unstoppable Force can’t knock up several of you. Counterattack right after his dash ends. Pull enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and endure the fight within Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s aura. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on a key champion you can kill within its time limit, and leave Malphite out if his high health makes him difficult to kill.
Malphite.watch: Malphite R Unstoppable Force is an unstoppable dash, so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp can’t interrupt it. When Malphite’s position is unknown, don’t group with your allies near walls or bushes. Don’t start a trade right after Malphite Q Seismic Shard hits and slows you.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus’s main damage, Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. Nasus E Spirit Fire and Nasus R Fury of the Sands deal magic damage, which armor alone can’t block; factor in that damage when you need magic resistance. Your armor is reduced while you’re in Nasus E Spirit Fire’s area, so don’t stay in it.
Nasus.combo: Pull Nasus in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp when he steps up to last-hit. Weave in an attack, then use Mordekaiser Q Obliterate so it hits Nasus alone. Once three hits from your abilities and attacks activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s aura, use the movement speed boost to stick close. After trading damage once, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield.
Nasus.escape: After Nasus W Wither is down, you have a chance to engage without being hindered by its slow. Nasus has no ability to create distance on his own, so catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp when he steps up to last-hit. Delay your engage while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active unless you have a clear advantage.
Nasus.fight: Use Mordekaiser W Indestructible after trading damage to build up its shield. If Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active, don’t fight him without a clear advantage.
Nasus.laning: Pressure Nasus when he steps up to last-hit so he can’t stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike freely. If you push the wave under Nasus’s turret, he can stack easily, so it’s better to let the wave come toward you and call for a jungle gank. Denying him room to stack early slows the trend of you falling further behind as the game goes on.
Nasus.phase: Keep an eye on Nasus’s stacks from mid game onward, and don’t face him for long in the late game as he grows stronger with each stack.
Nasus.teamfight: Group several enemies with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and bring them into range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s aura. Keep your distance instead of facing Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active. Choose a key target you can kill within the duration of Mordekaiser R Realm of Death, and use it after key abilities have been used.
Nasus.watch: Nasus W Wither reduces movement and attack speed, so don’t chase recklessly while affected. Nasus E Spirit Fire reduces armor, so leave the area. Nasus R Fury of the Sands increases his health and defensive stats, so avoid fighting and wait it out unless you have a clear advantage.

Ornn.build: Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so don’t focus on only one resistance. Mordekaiser has no ability to escape on his own, so if crowd control keeps you locked down for a long time, you can prioritize tenacity over resistances. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on max health, so be cautious about investing heavily in health alone.
Ornn.combo: Pull Ornn in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in an attack, then hit him with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Hit only Ornn with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, without overlapping a minion, then follow up with attacks to activate your passive aura. Activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible during a fight after damage has built up, and convert the shield to healing when it’s thick if you won’t take more damage.
Ornn.escape: Don’t rush to engage just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down; Ornn can still escape with Ornn R Call of the Forge God. In particular, catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp in the window before Ornn R Call of the Forge God comes back up and after Ornn E Searing Charge is down.
Ornn.fight: When Ornn steps forward to last-hit, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to start a trade. If Ornn E Searing Charge and Ornn R Call of the Forge God are available, don’t rush the chase. Once your passive aura is active, use the movement speed boost to stick close and fight; after trading damage, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield.
Ornn.laning: Lane away from walls and the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture. If Ornn tries to craft an item, stick close and attack to interrupt him.
Ornn.phase: Ornn’s damage is low in the early game, so start trades from a safe position to get ahead. Keep up the pressure in the mid game before Ornn’s items and allied Masterwork upgrades stack up. In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take only one enemy, so choose your target carefully based on the enemy team composition.
Ornn.teamfight: Move out of the line between the elemental from Ornn R Call of the Forge God and Ornn to avoid the knockup. When you engage, pull several enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, keep them in range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and your passive aura, and endure the fight. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important enemy you can kill within its duration. If Ornn engages on an allied damage dealer, you can take Ornn away to stop the engage.
Ornn.watch: Near the pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and walls, you can be knocked up by Ornn E Searing Charge, so retreat into the open. If you’re made Brittle by the final blast of Ornn W Bellows Breath, keep your distance. When you see Ornn R Call of the Forge God, move out of the line between the elemental and Ornn, and dodge the return path as well.

Pantheon.build: Build armor first against Pantheon’s main damage. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone. Also avoid stacking too much armor, considering Pantheon R Grand Starfall’s penetration.
Pantheon.combo: Pull Pantheon in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in one basic attack, then hit him with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate so it hits Pantheon alone, without overlapping minions, to increase its damage. After these three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise and chase with the movement speed increase.
Pantheon.escape: Look to engage after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down. It’s especially hard for him to escape if Pantheon R Grand Starfall is not available and you pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. If only one of his mobility tools is down, check whether the other is still available.
Pantheon.fight: When Pantheon steps forward to last-hit, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and keep close, weaving in basic attacks until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, wait out the frontal block or move to the side for an angle.
Pantheon.laning: Early on, focus on not giving Pantheon a kill. Stand behind minions when he pokes with Pantheon Q Comet Spear to take reduced damage from the back.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off as the game goes on, but Mordekaiser’s teamfight impact depends on whom you take into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Pantheon.teamfight: Group several enemies with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, and hold your ground within its area. If Pantheon dives your allied damage dealer, you can take him into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop the engage. It’s safer to cast Mordekaiser R Realm of Death after Pantheon has used his key abilities.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault is a targeted stun, so you can’t dodge it once you’re in range. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the direction he faces, so don’t cast Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from the front; wait for it to end or move to the side for an angle.

Poppy.build: Build armor first against Poppy’s main damage from Q Hammer Shock, E Heroic Charge, and R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about relying on health alone. Don’t spend extra resources on magic resistance just for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: When Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit Poppy alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. These three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s aura; use the increased movement speed to stay close and fight. After trading damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible.
Poppy.escape: The moment Poppy E Heroic Charge is down is your chance to close the gap. If Poppy starts charging R Keeper's Verdict, move out of her frontal path and look for an angle to engage again after avoiding the knockback.
Poppy.fight: Bait Poppy E Heroic Charge, then pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and fight. Walk out of the remaining Poppy Q Hammer Shock zone before re-engaging. After trading damage once, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield; if you won’t take more damage, convert the remaining shield into healing.
Poppy.laning: When Poppy steps forward to last-hit, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to start a trade, but don’t fight with a wall behind you. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate so it hits Poppy alone, without hitting minions. When her thrown shield lands, step on it first along a safe path to prevent Poppy P Iron Ambassador from granting her a shield.
Poppy.phase: In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take only one enemy, so your impact depends on the enemy composition and your target choice.
Poppy.teamfight: Group several enemies with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hold your ground within range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s aura. If Poppy dives your allied damage dealer, you can take her into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death. After the enemy’s key champion uses their major abilities, take an important target you can kill before the duration ends into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Poppy.watch: Stand in open space, since Poppy E Heroic Charge can stun you against a wall. If Poppy Q Hammer Shock hits you, move out before its second damage instance hits instead of staying in place. When Poppy charges R Keeper's Verdict, move sideways out of her frontal path. Carefully assess your finishing damage when Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active or when her low health has increased her armor and magic resistance.

Renekton.build: Build armor first against the main damage from Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Renekton Q Cull the Meek’s healing is a problem, buy Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s damage over time.
Renekton.combo: When Renekton E Slice and Dice is down, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit him with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate so it hits Renekton alone, without overlapping minions. After three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise and chase. After trading damage, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield; if you won’t take more damage, convert the shield into healing while it is large.
Renekton.escape: The moment Renekton E Slice and Dice is used to disengage is your window to go in. If Renekton W Ruthless Predator is down too, pull him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and fight while he has trouble escaping.
Renekton.fight: Trade when Renekton’s Fury bar from P Reign of Anger is empty or right after Renekton E Slice and Dice is used. Once Renekton has used Renekton Q Cull the Meek, Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and Renekton E Slice and Dice, catch him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and fight, weaving in basic attacks until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates.
Renekton.laning: Be careful where you stand: standing in or behind your minion wave gives Renekton E Slice and Dice a platform to engage from. When Renekton steps in front of the minions to build fury, pull him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and start a trade if his fury is empty.
Renekton.phase: If you avoid giving Renekton kills and keep growing, his value falls off from the mid game onward, so look for more opportunities to fight then. In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can isolate only one enemy, so choosing the target matters.
Renekton.teamfight: Group several enemies with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hold your ground with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active. After the enemy’s key champion has used their major abilities, use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on a target you can kill within its duration. If Renekton dives your allied damage dealer, you can also take him into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop the engage.
Renekton.watch: When Renekton P Reign of Anger is near or above half, watch for an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator and stay out of its range. This ability breaks shields first, so don’t rely on Mordekaiser W Indestructible to block his initial combo.

Riven.build: All of Riven’s damage is physical, so build armor first. If Riven gets ahead, prioritize defensive items earlier and build health to withstand her finisher. Attack speed reduction also helps reduce her basic attack damage.
Riven.combo: When Riven’s mobility abilities are down, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit Riven alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Follow with basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise and use the increased movement speed to stay close.
Riven.escape: If you engage after Riven has used only one cast of Riven Q Broken Wings, she can escape with her remaining dashes or Riven E Valor. In particular, pull her in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp during the window when her mobility abilities have been expended and before Riven Q Broken Wings comes back. Also watch for Riven W Ki Burst and the crowd control on the third cast of Riven Q Broken Wings before engaging.
Riven.fight: Look to counterattack when Riven uses Riven Q Broken Wings to clear minions. Don’t cast Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp first while Riven still has her dashes available; push her away immediately after getting into close range, or pull her in after she expends her mobility abilities. After trading damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield.
Riven.laning: Early on, don’t step too far forward while Riven still has all her dashes available. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate so it hits Riven alone without overlapping minions.
Riven.phase: The available information doesn’t establish who has the advantage in the mid game. In the late game, Mordekaiser’s impact depends on whom you can take into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Riven.teamfight: Group several enemies with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hold your ground with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on a target you can kill before the duration ends, after a key enemy champion has used their key abilities. If Riven engages on your allied damage dealer, you can take her to stop the engage.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings closes the gap with chained dashes and a knock-up, while Riven W Ki Burst stuns you once she gets close. When you see the first dash, retreat; if she catches you, interrupt her combo with the forced movement from Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. While Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her range and Attack Damage increase, and its finisher damage proportional to missing health is dangerous, so keep your distance until it expires.

Rumble.build: Choose magic resistance on your first defensive item. Rumble P Junkyard Titan and Rumble Q Flamespitter deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on health alone.
Rumble.combo: Pull Rumble in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, hit Rumble alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, then follow with another basic attack. These three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After trading damage once, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield; if you won’t take more damage, convert it into healing while the shield is large.
Rumble.escape: After Rumble uses Rumble W Scrap Shield, wait briefly for the shield to wear off, then engage with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp. Rumble has no mobility ability, so pulling him in gives you a chance to stay close and fight. If the first cast of Rumble E Electro Harpoon hits you, don’t force the engage; create distance before the second arrives.
Rumble.fight: When Rumble steps forward to last-hit, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to start a trade. If Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, let the shield wear off briefly before closing in. Weave in basic attacks until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, then use the movement speed increase to stick to him.
Rumble.laning: Set up a situation where Rumble has to walk forward, and aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate so it hits him alone without overlapping minions.
Rumble.phase: In the late game, you can take only one enemy with R, so your impact depends on the enemy composition and your target choice.
Rumble.teamfight: Group several enemies with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hold your ground within range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill before the duration ends, after a key enemy champion has used their key abilities. Choose your initial engage position carefully.
Rumble.watch: Dodge the first cast of Rumble E Electro Harpoon. Consecutive hits apply a stronger slow and reduce your magic resistance, so if the first one hits, create distance before the second arrives. Also limit the time you spend within range of Rumble Q Flamespitter.

Sett.build: Build armor first to counter Sett’s basic attacks and Sett Q Knuckle Down. You can also reduce his attack speed to take less damage from basic attacks. Sett Q Knuckle Down scales with your maximum health, and resistance does not reduce the true damage at the center of Sett W Haymaker, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: When Sett steps forward, pull him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit Sett alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise with three hits, then use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield after trading damage. When Sett uses Sett W Haymaker, step to the side of its center.
Sett.escape: If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, you have less reason to worry about its stun. Mordekaiser has no ability to escape on his own, so manage your distance carefully while both abilities are available.
Sett.fight: Mix in basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, but briefly back away after dealing enough damage to make Sett use Sett W Haymaker. Re-engage once Sett W Haymaker’s Grit has cooled down.
Sett.laning: Use Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that hits Sett without overlapping with minions. To avoid the stun from Sett E Facebreaker, don’t stand with minions on the opposite side of Sett.
Sett.phase: In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take only one enemy, so choosing an important target you can kill is crucial.
Sett.teamfight: If Sett engages on an allied damage dealer, take Sett with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop the engage. Otherwise, choose an important enemy champion you can kill before the duration ends. Pull several enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then survive while avoiding the center of Sett W Haymaker.
Sett.watch: Sett E Facebreaker stuns if enemies are on both sides of him, so position yourself to avoid getting caught between a minion wave and Sett. Sett W Haymaker grows stronger immediately after he takes damage, so briefly back away after dealing damage. If you can’t dodge it easily, move to the side of the aiming line’s center to avoid the true damage.

Shen.build: The time spent taunted by Shen E Shadow Dash is dangerous, so consider tenacity first. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don’t focus on just one type of resistance. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on health alone.
Shen.combo: When Shen E Shadow Dash misses and Shen W Spirit's Refuge has ended, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit him with Q Obliterate. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate so it hits Shen alone without overlapping minions. These three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s aura; chase with it active and use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield after trading damage.
Shen.escape: Shen E Shadow Dash is his only mobility ability and his forced crowd control, so immediately after it misses is your window to engage. Shen R Stand United is also a means of movement, so don’t automatically engage just because Shen E Shadow Dash is down. Before Shen R Stand United comes back off cooldown, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to start a fight.
Shen.fight: Land abilities and basic attacks to stay close until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s aura activates, then use Mordekaiser W Indestructible after trading damage.
