If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, damage him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and Q Obliterate while your basic attacks are blocked.
Shen.laning: Early on, focus on gaining lane priority and pushing the lane to keep Shen occupied with CS rather than forcing a kill. If Shen uses Shen R Stand United to move elsewhere, take advantage of the empty lane.
Shen.phase: In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take only one enemy, so your impact depends on the enemy composition and your target.
Shen.teamfight: Shen can join fights elsewhere with Shen R Stand United, so alert your team if he leaves lane or starts channeling. In teamfights, group several enemies with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hold your ground with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s aura active. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on a target you can kill before the duration ends, after a key enemy champion has used their key abilities. If Shen uses Shen E Shadow Dash to engage on your allied damage dealer, you can take him into Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop the engage.
Shen.watch: If Shen E Shadow Dash taunts you, you’ll be hit by the empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault, so dodge the dash. Also move out of the path of Shen Q Twilight Assault’s returning spirit blade. While Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, Mordekaiser’s basic attacks are blocked, but his ability damage still gets through.

Singed.build: Consider movement speed items first so you can walk out of Singed Q Poison Trail. Singed Q Poison Trail and Singed E Fling both deal magic damage, so build magic resistance. Singed E Fling deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid relying on health alone.
Singed.combo: Pull Singed in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit him alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that doesn’t overlap minions. Land three hits with abilities and basic attacks combined to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After trading damage once, use Mordekaiser W Indestructible. If you won’t take more damage, recast Mordekaiser W Indestructible while the shield is large to heal.
Singed.escape: Singed has no ability that creates distance on its own, so engage with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp when you have an opening to catch him. If you wait until Singed W Mega Adhesive and Singed E Fling are dodged or used, you can avoid the root combo on the adhesive. If adhesive is under your feet, detour around it first.
Singed.fight: When Singed steps forward to last-hit, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp to start a trade. Weave in basic attacks and stay close until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates, but don’t chase recklessly through Singed Q Poison Trail.
Singed.phase: Once Singed completes his core items, he becomes difficult to kill, so don’t chase through his poison. Choose your target carefully for Mordekaiser R Realm of Death in the late game.
Singed.teamfight: If Singed runs at your allies, hold him with Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and attack his allies in the meantime instead of chasing him to the end. Choose an important target you can kill before Mordekaiser R Realm of Death expires, and use it after the enemy has used their key abilities.
Singed.watch: Singed Q Poison Trail lingers along his escape route, so don’t chase even if he looks low unless you have enough damage to secure the kill. Detour around areas covered by Singed W Mega Adhesive so you don’t get hit by Singed E Fling on it and then rooted. Don’t stand in front of Singed if he has his allies behind him.

Sion.build: Build armor first against the damage from Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Sion W Soul Furnace or Sion E Roar of the Slayer. Avoid Sion E Roar of the Slayer first, since it also reduces your armor, and be wary of relying on health alone because Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on your maximum health.
Sion.combo: Dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash to the side, then pull him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp. Weave in a basic attack, then hit Sion with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that doesn’t overlap with minions. Land three hits with abilities and basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then fight at close range. Activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible once damage has built up.
Sion.escape: After dodging the crowd control from Sion Q Decimating Smash, pull Sion with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp. With no mobility outside his ultimate, Sion will have difficulty escaping.
Sion.fight: Pull Sion with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, then hit him with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. When Sion W Soul Furnace is active, focus your damage before its shield explodes, then use Mordekaiser W Indestructible to survive after trading damage.
Sion.laning: Early on, keep enough distance to dodge Sion Q Decimating Smash and Sion E Roar of the Slayer. If you keep giving Sion CS, his maximum health will grow, so push the lane to disrupt his farming or make gains in another lane during that time.
Sion.phase: As time passes, Sion’s maximum health grows through CS, so disrupt his farming or make gains in another lane. The impact of Mordekaiser R Realm of Death in the late game depends on the enemy team composition and which target you isolate.
Sion.teamfight: Sidestep Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught. If Sion is on an allied damage dealer, you can take him with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop the engage. However, Sion is a high-health frontline target, so choose another important target if he would be difficult to kill before the duration ends. Pull several enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and fight within the range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After Sion goes down, reposition for Sion P Glory in Death.
Sion.watch: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, move to the side to avoid the knock-up and stun. Don’t meet Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught in a narrow path; sidestep it. Sion E Roar of the Slayer reduces your armor and slows you, so manage your distance carefully if it hits. After killing Sion, reposition away from where he revives with Sion P Glory in Death.

Skarner.build: Build magic resistance first against the damage from Skarner P Threads of Vibration, Skarner W Seismic Bastion, and Skarner R Impale. If you need to remove suppression, first decide whether to include Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar in your build.
Skarner.combo: When Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is down, pull him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit Skarner alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Land three hits with abilities and basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then fight at close range. When using Mordekaiser R Realm of Death, choose a sure target while you’re close, immediately after pulling him.
Skarner.escape: Go in right after making Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact. Pulling him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp at that moment makes it hard for him to escape. Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp can’t interrupt Skarner R Impale, so manage your distance before he catches you to avoid the suppression.
Skarner.fight: Immediately after making Skarner use Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact is your chance to close the distance. Pull him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp at that moment, then hit him with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that doesn’t overlap with minions. After one exchange of damage, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible to survive.
Skarner.laning: Don’t stand with your back to a wall, and watch for engage range from Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact and Skarner R Impale.
Skarner.phase: In the late game, you can take only one enemy, so choose an important target you can kill within the time limit.
Skarner.teamfight: If Skarner engages on an allied damage dealer, you can take him with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop the engage. Avoid high-health frontline targets that are difficult to kill in time, and choose a target after an enemy core champion has used their key abilities. Pull enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and survive within the range of Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, but watch your position near the edges of the dragon or Baron pit so Skarner R Impale can’t drag you away.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal’s Impact dashes through terrain, and he stuns you if he catches you and slams you into a wall. Don’t stand with your back to a wall; keep your distance in open space, and back away after hitting a wall in case he dashes again. Don’t easily enter range of Skarner R Impale, which suppresses and drags you.

TahmKench.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste, Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, and Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive. If healing makes the duel drag on, buy Morellonomicon earlier. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise’s damage over time makes it easy to maintain Grievous Wounds.
TahmKench.combo: Pull Tahm Kench with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit him alone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Land three hits with abilities and basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then use the movement speed increase to pressure him. After one exchange of damage, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible, and if you aren’t about to take more damage, convert the remaining shield into healing.
TahmKench.escape: After Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, he has difficulty engaging and escaping, so look for a chance to catch him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste stacks remain, back away first and engage after they wear off.
TahmKench.fight: When Tahm Kench steps forward to last-hit, pull him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp to start a trade. If you hit him a little at a time and back away, it’s hard to deal with the shield and healing from Tahm Kench E Thick Skin, so engage from an angle where you can activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise and keep up the pressure. Use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield after trading damage.
TahmKench.laning: Use Mordekaiser Q Obliterate from an angle that avoids minions and hits only Tahm Kench. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, stop trading and wait out the stacks from beyond his range.
TahmKench.phase: Your late-game impact depends on whether Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take an important enemy champion at the right time, based on the enemy team composition.
TahmKench.teamfight: Pressure the carry Tahm Kench is protecting instead of trying to kill Tahm Kench first, but account for the fact that Tahm Kench R Devour can protect the carry while it’s available. If an ally is swallowed, focus your damage on the slowed Tahm Kench. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill before the duration ends, after they have used their key abilities.
TahmKench.watch: If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has stacked twice, back away and wait for the stacks to wear off. A third basic attack or a hit from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash can set up both a stun and Tahm Kench R Devour. If you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, back away to avoid the area knock-up at its landing point.

Teemo.build: Teemo’s main damage from Teemo Q Blinding Dart, Teemo E Toxic Shot, and Teemo R Noxious Trap is magic, so build magic resistance first. When preparing for a team fight, use Oracle Lens to clear traps from key paths.
Teemo.combo: After Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, pull him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, then follow up with a basic attack and Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate to hit only Teemo without overlapping with minions. After three hits activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then chase with the increased movement speed.
Teemo.escape: Right after Teemo uses Teemo Q Blinding Dart is a good time to engage with a basic attack mixed in. Teemo W Move Quick increases his movement speed, so pull him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp when you can close the distance.
Teemo.fight: Taking a single basic attack and backing away is an unfavorable trade because of Teemo E Toxic Shot. When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down and you can get close, close the distance with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and commit to the fight. Use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield after trading damage.
Teemo.laning: Don’t push the wave early; farm safely with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Teemo can hide with Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare, so don’t pass by bushes without vision.
Teemo.phase: Early on, farm safely while avoiding Teemo’s ranged basic attacks and poison. In the late game, watch for traps Teemo has had in place for a long time, and choose carefully whom to take with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap near objectives and in narrow passages. Pull several enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and survive within the range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on a target you can kill before the duration ends, after an enemy core champion has used their key abilities.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart blocks basic attacks, but not ability damage. Don’t insist on basic attacks while blinded; respond with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate or back away. Teemo R Noxious Trap is invisible and slows you when triggered, so watch for traps near objectives and in narrow paths.

Trundle.build: Build armor first against Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate deals magic damage based on your maximum health and steals resistances, so don’t try to counter it by stacking only health or resistances. If healing from Trundle P King’s Tribute is a problem, buy Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise.
Trundle.combo: Pull Trundle with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp from outside Trundle W Frozen Domain, weave in a basic attack, then use Mordekaiser Q Obliterate to hit Trundle alone. Keep landing hits to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then use Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield after trading damage. If you aren’t about to take more damage, recast W while the shield is large to heal.
Trundle.escape: The opening to engage comes when Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and he has left Trundle W Frozen Domain. Trundle has no ability to create distance on his own, so catch him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp to start a trade.
Trundle.fight: Don’t take a fight while Trundle W Frozen Domain is active; back away and re-engage once you’re outside it. If it ends and you can engage in open terrain, pull Trundle with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Don’t continue dueling while Trundle R Subjugate is active.
Trundle.laning: Pull Trundle when he steps forward to last-hit, but use Q to hit only Trundle without overlapping with minions. Trundle heals around the wave with Trundle P King’s Tribute, so after whittling down health, take an advantage or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.teamfight: Pull several enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and survive with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on a target you can kill before the duration ends, after an enemy core champion has used their key abilities. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, don’t fight Trundle head-on; target someone else or back away.
Trundle.watch: While inside Trundle W Frozen Domain, his attack speed, movement speed, and incoming healing increase, so move outside it and wait out its duration. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape in narrow paths, so fight in open terrain and immediately move to the side when the pillar appears. While Trundle R Subjugate is active, he steals your armor and magic resistance, making him harder to kill, so back away.

Tryndamere.build: Tryndamere’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Consider Thornmail to punish his reliance on basic attacks. If the healing from Tryndamere Q Bloodlust becomes a problem, use Morellonomicon to maintain Grievous Wounds.
Tryndamere.combo: When Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp. Weave in basic attacks, then use Mordekaiser Q Obliterate to hit Tryndamere alone, followed by another basic attack to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Convert the damage accumulated during the fight into a shield with Mordekaiser W Indestructible; if you don’t expect to take more damage, recast it to heal while the shield is still large.
Tryndamere.escape: Engage right after making Tryndamere use E Spinning Slash. It can come back quickly where there are many minions, so draw him into an area without minions before landing Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp. If Tryndamere W Mocking Shout hits you, don’t immediately commit to a basic-attack trade.
Tryndamere.fight: The moment Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down is your chance to engage. Pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, then hit only Tryndamere with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, avoiding the minions. After trading damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield, and keep your distance when Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active.
Tryndamere.laning: Early on, harass Tryndamere when he steps up to last-hit so he can’t build Fury. When backing away, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid the slow from Tryndamere W Mocking Shout.
Tryndamere.phase: In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can isolate one enemy, but its impact in a teamfight depends on the enemy composition.
Tryndamere.teamfight: Pull in multiple enemies with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and hold your ground with Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise active. If Tryndamere dives onto an allied damage dealer, you can take him with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop the engage, but he is difficult to kill within its duration while Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active. If Tryndamere R Undying Rage is ready while he is split-pushing, don’t go stop him alone; trade for an objective or send more allies.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury builds Fury, making his critical strikes dangerous, so keep your distance while he attacks minions to build Fury. Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is a dash, and critical strikes reduce its cooldown, so don’t chase him where there are many minions. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, he can’t be killed, so stop dealing damage and keep your distance until it expires.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage. Udyr Q Wilding Claw has two damage types, and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone won’t block all his damage. Consider Morellonomicon if healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle is a problem.
Udyr.combo: After Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down, pull him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, weave in a basic attack, then hit him with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate to hit only Udyr without overlapping with minions, increasing its single-target damage. Land three hits with abilities and basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then fight at close range and chase.
Udyr.escape: The opening to counterattack is right after Udyr engages with Udyr E Blazing Stampede and has used its stun. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is Awakened, so catch him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp after the Awakening ends. Udyr moves quickly, making it hard to create distance on foot, so don’t use Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp too early.
Udyr.fight: After Udyr E Blazing Stampede is down and his Awakening has ended, catch him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp. Once Udyr W Iron Mantle’s shield is gone, activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise and keep up the pressure so he has no chance to heal. Use Mordekaiser W Indestructible after trading damage and building up a shield.
Udyr.laning: Udyr starts in the jungle and appears for ganks, so place vision on key paths and jungle entrances. Don’t step forward in lane while Udyr is missing. Even if Udyr approaches, avoid forcing a fight until both Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and Mordekaiser Q Obliterate are ready.
Udyr.phase: In the late game, you can take only one enemy with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death, so your team-fight impact depends on your target choice.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to burn down Udyr first when he’s made tanky by defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle; prioritize weaker enemies in the backline. If Udyr engages on an allied damage dealer, you can take him with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop the engage. If you can kill another important target, use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death after that target has used their key abilities.
Udyr.watch: Udyr can quickly approach and stun you with Udyr E Blazing Stampede, so keep your distance right after he refreshes his stance. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede stuns you once, take advantage of the period when it can’t stun the same target again for a while. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on health alone to withstand them.

Urgot.build: Urgot’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking only health, and account for the execute threshold from Urgot R Fear Beyond Death.
Urgot.combo: When Urgot E Disdain is down, pull him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and hit him with a basic attack and Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Aim Mordekaiser Q Obliterate to hit only Urgot without overlapping with minions. Land three hits with abilities and basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then use Mordekaiser W Indestructible after trading damage.
Urgot.escape: The opening to engage comes right after Urgot E Disdain is down. If you also dodge Urgot Q Corrosive Charge, you have less reason to worry about being slowed and focused by his fire, so close the distance with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp.
Urgot.fight: Close the distance and catch Urgot with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp right after Urgot E Disdain is down. If you stay beside Urgot for too long, damage from his leg cannons will build up, so wait just outside their short range before engaging. Use Mordekaiser W Indestructible for a shield after one exchange of damage.
Urgot.laning: Don’t push the wave early; farm safely with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Since Mordekaiser has no mobility, forcing an engage can easily cost you health, so keep your distance until Urgot E Disdain is down.
Urgot.phase: Early on, it’s safer for Mordekaiser to avoid direct fights and farm. In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can isolate one enemy, but its impact depends on the enemy team composition.
Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so stand behind your allied frontline to limit his engage angle. Pull several enemies together with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and fight within the range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death on an important target you can kill before the duration ends, after an enemy core champion has used their key abilities.
Urgot.watch: Keep your distance so you aren’t hit first by Urgot E Disdain, which dashes in and stuns. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, it slows you and marks you for Urgot W Purge, so dodge it as it flies toward you. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, move completely out of range before you reach the execute threshold.

Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. P The Relentless Storm and E Sky Splitter deal magic damage, so armor alone won’t stop them; E Sky Splitter also deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about relying on large increases in health alone. Consider Morellonomicon if the healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul becomes a problem.
Volibear.combo: Pull Volibear in with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, weave in basic attacks, then cast Q Obliterate so it hits Volibear alone. Land three hits with abilities and basic attacks combined to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise, then stay on him with the movement speed bonus. Once damage has built up, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible; if you don’t expect to take more damage, recast it to heal while the shield is still large.
Volibear.escape: Wait out the stun from Volibear Q Thundering Smash beyond basic-attack range, then engage just after his P The Relentless Storm stacks are gone. If only Volibear Q Thundering Smash is down, he can escape with R Stormbringer, so catch him with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp while R Stormbringer is still unavailable too.
Volibear.fight: When Volibear steps up to last-hit and his P The Relentless Storm stacks are down, start the trade with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp. Stay on him and weave in basic attacks until Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. Sidestep when the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter appears, then activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible’s shield after trading damage.
Volibear.laning: Cast Mordekaiser Q Obliterate at an angle that hits only Volibear, without overlapping the minions.
Volibear.phase: In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can exclude only one enemy, so your choice of target affects its impact in a teamfight.
Volibear.teamfight: Pull in multiple enemies with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and hold your ground with P Darkness Rise active. If Volibear dives onto an allied damage dealer, you can take him with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop the engage. Use R Realm of Death after the enemy’s key abilities are down, on an important target you can kill within its duration.
Volibear.watch: When Volibear approaches with Q Thundering Smash active, watch for the empowered basic attack’s stun and wait it out beyond basic-attack range. If you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, sidestep to avoid its damage and slow. Don’t take a fight while Volibear has built up P The Relentless Storm stacks by attacking minions.

Yone.build: Get movement speed first so it’s easier to leave Yone’s telegraphed engage range. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t focus your resistances on just one type. Avoid stacking health alone because Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on maximum health. Attack speed reduction also helps delay the cooldowns of Yone Q Mortal Steel and W Spirit Cleave.
Yone.combo: Pull Yone in with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, weave in basic attacks, then hit only Yone with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate, avoiding the minions. Follow with a basic attack or ability to activate the Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise aura, then stay on him with the movement speed bonus. After trading damage, hold your ground with Mordekaiser W Indestructible; if you can secure the kill, cast Mordekaiser R Realm of Death right after using E to close the gap.
Yone.escape: Don’t engage while Yone Q Mortal Steel’s tornado is ready; wait for the stacks to disappear. After Yone dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, look for a chance to land the forced movement from Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and delay his return. Engage especially before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back, after confirming he has used his other mobility too.
Yone.fight: Keep your distance while Yone’s tornado Q is ready, and start a fight after the stacks disappear or after he engages. When Yone steps up to last-hit, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp to start a trade, then stay on him with basic attacks and Mordekaiser Q Obliterate to activate your passive aura. After trading damage once, activate Mordekaiser W Indestructible to use the shield.
Yone.phase: In the late game, Mordekaiser’s impact depends greatly on who he takes with R.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave’s shield doesn’t grow as large, and form up with the landing position after a hit from Yone R Fate Sealed in mind. If Yone dives onto an allied damage dealer, take him with Mordekaiser R Realm of Death to stop the engage. Pull in multiple enemies with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp to activate your passive aura, but choose your initial engage position carefully since you have no mobility ability.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly casts Q Mortal Steel on minions, his tornado is ready, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear. When he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, account for the extra damage when he returns, and dodge the path and arrival point of Yone R Fate Sealed.

Yorick.build: Yorick Q Last Rites and the Mist Walkers’ attacks deal physical damage, so build armor first. Yorick E Mourning Mist and R Eulogy of the Isles deal magic damage and damage based on your maximum health, so avoid greatly increasing health alone. Consider Morellonomicon if the healing from Yorick Q Last Rites becomes a problem.
Yorick.combo: When Yorick steps up to last-hit, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp, weave in basic attacks, then hit him with Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Cast Q Obliterate to hit only Yorick, without overlapping the minions, then follow with a basic attack to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. After trading damage once, gain a shield with Mordekaiser W Indestructible; if you have a clear opening for a duel, cast Mordekaiser R Realm of Death right after pulling him in.
Yorick.escape: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, look for a chance to step up to farm or engage. If Yorick uses W Dark Procession, break the wall if you get trapped, then look for another opening. Yorick has no ability to create distance on his own, so pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp when you have an opening.
Yorick.fight: After dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist, pull him in with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp to start a trade when he steps up to last-hit. Once you’re on him, weave in basic attacks to activate Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise and pressure him with the movement speed bonus. Where Yorick has many Mist Walkers or the Maiden of the Mist is attacking alongside him, clear out his forces first before fighting.
Yorick.laning: Don’t start a fight near Yorick where many graves have built up. Push the wave so minions die under Yorick’s turret, making it harder for him to build graves on his side.
Yorick.phase: In the mid game, handle Yorick’s split-push pressure while also looking for opportunities to trade for objectives elsewhere. In the late game, Mordekaiser R Realm of Death can take only one enemy, so focus on choosing the right target.
Yorick.teamfight: Pull in multiple enemies with Mordekaiser E Death’s Grasp and hold your ground within range of Mordekaiser Q Obliterate and Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise. Use Mordekaiser R Realm of Death after a key enemy champion has used their main abilities, choosing a target you can kill within its duration. Before taking Yorick, judge whether you can kill him, and don’t force an engage where his Mist Walkers and the Maiden of the Mist are present.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on your maximum health, so watch its arc and dodge it. If you’re trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, break the wall with basic attacks. When the Maiden of the Mist summoned by Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles starts attacking you, move away from Yorick to avoid further damage.
